01 / Our story

A little more care in every cup.

Field & Ember began with a simple idea: exceptional coffee should feel welcoming. We seek out distinctive coffees and roast them with care, bringing out the character of each origin without losing the comfort of a familiar daily ritual.

From the first grind to the last sip, we believe good coffee is best shared.

03 / Brewing tips

Make a better cup at home.

01

Start fresh

Grind whole beans just before brewing. Use filtered water and store coffee sealed, cool and away from sunlight.

02

Find your ratio

For filter coffee, start with 15 g coffee to 250 g water, heated to about 92–96°C (198–205°F). Adjust to taste.

03

Dial it in

Try a medium grind for pour-over. If your cup tastes sour, grind a little finer; if it tastes harsh or bitter, grind a little coarser.
